description:
FILED s536b (Opus 5.5, 2026-11-08) from a #4521 probe.  PRE-EXISTING on main 0affbe86 and c950ad43 (SILENT WRONG).

REPRODUCER (scratch/s536b/p/u3.pl in the s536b worktree; perl 5.40.3):

    package Q::FS; use parent "File::Spec";
    package main; print Q::FS->catfile("a", "b"), " ", File::Spec->catfile("a","b"), "\n";

perl: `a/b a/b`.   PCL: `Q::FS/a/b a/b`.

MECHANISM: lib/File/Spec.pm (PCL's shim) decides whether its first argument is the invocant with `shift if @_ > 0 && !ref($_[0]) && $_[0] eq 'File::Spec'` (catfile line 42; the sibling methods are likely the same).  perl's File::Spec is File::Spec::Unix, whose methods ALWAYS shift self (they are only ever called as methods), so any subclass invocant -- `use parent 'File::Spec'`, File::Spec::Unix, an object -- is the invocant.  Layer: the lib/ shim (rule 9a).  Fix shape: shift the invocant when it is a class name that ->isa('File::Spec') (or always, if the function form `File::Spec::catfile(...)` is not a supported spelling -- check lib/File/Spec/Functions.pm, which calls File::Spec->catfile(@_)).
BAR: the reproducer; every method of the shim with the same test; a guard row.
subject: lib/File/Spec.pm shim: a SUBCLASS invocant is not shifted -- `package Q::FS; use parent "File::Spec"; Q::FS->catfile("a", "b")` answers "Q::FS/a/b" (perl: "a/b"); the shim's invocant test is `$_[0] eq 'File::Spec'`
